_comment: Hand-identified functions, applied by tools/ghidra/ApplyFacts.java. One entry per function: the name, and the evidence. Names follow the 3.3.5 originals where the function is the same one.

0x140255140.name: SMemAlloc
0x140255140.evidence: rounds size to 16, writes a block header (size|1), falls back to _malloc_base/_calloc_base; 3,672 call sites pass an RTTI type-name string where 3.3.5 passed __FILE__

0x140255210.name: SMemFree
0x140255210.evidence: checks the block header and reports Storm's 'Memory corrupted -- %s %d'; 10,013 call sites pass a type-name tag

0x142430eb0.name: GetData
0x142430eb0.evidence: src Engine/Source/Base/CDataAllocator.cpp; pops a block off a free list, refilling it in chunks from SMemAlloc

0x140271fe0.name: _CxxThrowException
0x140271fe0.evidence: builds the C++ exception record with magic 0x19930520 and raises it; every call site is dead-ended (noreturn.py)

0x140272d6c.name: _endthreadex
0x140272d6c.evidence: common_end_thread(retval) then int3, the CRT's exact body

0x1402b30b0.name: lua_gettop
0x1402b30b0.evidence: C_ field registration (tools/cregister.py form 2): its int result is the table index later passed to lua_setfield

0x1402b3880.name: lua_pushcclosure
0x1402b3880.evidence: C_ field registration: (L, lua_CFunction, 0) right before lua_setfield; 35 sites

0x1402b43c0.name: lua_setfield
0x1402b43c0.evidence: C_ field registration: (L, table index from lua_gettop, field name) after the push; 35 sites

0x1402b45d0.name: lua_settop
0x1402b45d0.evidence: C_ field registration: (L, -2) right after lua_setfield, i.e. lua_pop(L, 1)
